name: LUFS VU
author: drj-io
summary: Stereo analog VU meters plus an EBU R 128 loudness tab: integrated, short-term and momentary LUFS, true peak and gain reduction. Optional AUTO loudness steers towards a target (-23 to -9 LUFS) and an optional true-peak limiter holds a ceiling. Selectable calibration, clip lamps, phase meter. With processing off the audio passes through bit-exact.
